personajes.about: A prodigy soldier of the Scout Regiment and Eren's adoptive sister. She stands out for her superhuman combat strength and unwavering determination to protect him.
An impulsive youth from Shiganshina who vows to wipe out all Titans after losing his mother. He wields the power of the Attack Titan and fights for humanity's freedom.
Eren and Mikasa's closest friend, gifted with a brilliant strategic mind. Though he doubts his physical strength, his intellect repeatedly saves his comrades in critical moments.
Captain of the Special Operations Squad, renowned as humanity's strongest soldier. Cold-mannered and obsessive about cleanliness, he holds deep respect for Commander Erwin.
A 104th Cadet Corps graduate famous for her insatiable appetite and sharp hunter's intuition. She is a skilled markswoman with a bow and brings warmth and humor to the squad.
One of the top cadets of the 104th Corps, admired for his leadership and physical strength. Secretly, he is a Marleyan Warrior who possesses the Armored Titan.
An agile, light-hearted cadet from Ragako village who shares a close bond with Sasha. Despite his carefree personality, he displays remarkable courage on the battlefield.
A tall, quiet cadet with strong technical skills who always stays close to Reiner. He is the secret inheritor of the Colossal Titan responsible for breaching Wall Maria.
A solitary soldier and master of hand-to-hand combat who joins the Military Police. She conceals her true identity as the Female Titan infiltrating behind the Walls.
A Garrison soldier and longtime friend of the Yeager family who rescued Eren and Mikasa in Shiganshina. He strives to redeem his past fear by protecting the young recruits.
Commander of the Scout Regiment, a charismatic leader and bold strategist. He is willing to make ruthless sacrifices to uncover the truth about the outside world.
A pragmatic and outspoken cadet who initially aims for a comfortable life in the Military Police. Over time, he matures into a natural leader within the Scout Regiment.
Eren's mother and Grisha's wife, a loving and protective woman who opposes her son joining the Scouts. Her death during the fall of Shiganshina shapes Eren's entire path.
A respected doctor in Shiganshina and Eren's father who hides crucial secrets in his basement. His past beyond the Walls holds the key to understanding the Titans' origin.
An idealistic and empathetic cadet of the 104th Corps and Jean's close companion. His tragic death during the Battle of Trost inspires Jean to join the Scout Regiment.
A kind and compassionate recruit admired as a 'goddess' by her peers in the 104th Corps. Her true identity is Historia Reiss, the rightful heir to the royal throne.
A cadet of the 104th Corps from Trost and a close friend of Eren and Armin. He falls in battle while defending his hometown district against the Titans.
Supreme Commander of the Garrison Regiment in the southern territory, eccentric and fond of liquor. He possesses sharp tactical instincts and trusts Eren's plan to seal Trost.
An experienced and loyal member of Captain Levi's original Special Operations Squad. She excels with omni-directional mobility gear and shows kindness toward new recruits.
A Squad Leader in the Scout Regiment and humanity's second-strongest soldier after Levi. He possesses an extraordinary sense of smell capable of detecting Titans from afar.
A Squad Leader in the Scout Regiment passionate about researching Titans. Hange combines an eccentric, enthusiastic demeanor with a brilliant scientific mind.
Commander of the Military Police tasked with maintaining order inside the Walls. He frequently clashes with Erwin Smith over their opposing methods and priorities.
Premier and supreme commander of all three military branches within the Walls, calm in appearance yet ruthless in resolve. He presides over the military tribunal deciding Eren's fate.
A pastor of the Wall Cult who fanatically guards the secrets hidden inside the Walls. His vow of silence is put to the test by Hange and the Scout Regiment.
A member of the Scout Regiment who takes part in expeditions beyond the Walls under Commander Erwin Smith's leadership.
An idealistic recruit in the Military Police who enlists determined to root out internal corruption. His strong sense of justice soon aligns him with the Scout Regiment.
A Squad Leader in the Scout Regiment during the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission. He is a veteran officer known for his composure and exceptional horsemanship.
A Scout Regiment soldier who rides alongside Dita Ness on the right flank during the 57th expedition beyond the Walls.
A cynical, guarded cadet of the 104th Corps fiercely devoted to protecting Krista Lenz. She secretly holds the power of the Jaw Titan and a past predating the Walls.
A veteran Squad Leader in the Scout Regiment admired for her composure under pressure. She shows immense bravery while defending unarmed recruits at Utgard Castle.
A seasoned member of Levi's Special Operations Squad with an impressive Titan kill record. He tries to mimic Levi's stoic demeanor, though he often ends up biting his tongue.
Second-in-command of Levi's elite squad, respected for his calm judgment and tactical sense. He mentors and protects Eren during his integration into the Scout Regiment.
A disciplined and loyal soldier serving in Captain Levi's original squad. He strictly follows orders and security protocols throughout the regiment's expeditions.
An optimistic and dedicated cadet of the 104th Corps who fights in Eren's squad at Trost. She dies tragically during the counterattack to reclaim the district.
The stern Chief Instructor of the 104th Cadet Corps and former Commander of the Scout Regiment. He tests every recruit's resolve before sending them to the front lines.
A veteran Garrison soldier stationed in Shiganshina alongside Hannes. He maintains a relaxed attitude during peacetime before the fall of Wall Maria.
A young Scout Regiment soldier who loses his life during an expedition beyond the Walls, leaving behind only his severed right arm.
A resident of Shiganshina who receives the remains of her son Moses after a Scout expedition, questioning the meaning of humanity's heavy sacrifices.
Armin Arlert's grandfather, who raises him after his parents' disappearance and keeps the forbidden book about the outside world that inspires Armin and Eren's dreams.
A cadet of the 104th Corps who participates in the defense of Trost after the Colossal Titan's attack. He is rescued by Sasha after being knocked unconscious off the wall.
A 104th Corps recruit deeply in love with his fellow cadet Hannah Diamant. He loses his life during the brutal battle to defend the Trost District.
A cadet of the 104th Corps and Franz Kefka's partner during training and the Battle of Trost. She is left devastated while trying to revive him after the Titan assault.
A fearful recruit of the 104th Corps who suffers panic attacks when confronted with the horrors of the Titans in Trost, reflecting the terror of rookie soldiers.
An instructor of the 104th Cadet Corps responsible for evaluating trainees' physical aptitude and proficiency with omni-directional mobility gear.
A Garrison Captain who panics upon discovering Eren's ability to transform into a Titan, ordering his troops to open fire on him in Trost.
A Garrison Regiment soldier serving in the Trost District under the defense officers during the Titan invasion.
An officer and direct aide to Commander Dot Pyxis in the Garrison Regiment. He works closely with Pyxis to plan the operation to retake the Trost District.
A loyal Garrison soldier who serves as a trusted escort and aide to Commander Dot Pyxis during the military operations in Trost.
An elite Squad Leader of the Garrison Regiment in Trost, cold-headed and pragmatic. He willingly risks his life to protect Eren while sealing the breach in the wall.
A cadet of the 104th Corps assigned to the vanguard squad alongside Eren during the Battle of Trost, where he falls fighting against the Titans.
A 104th Corps recruit serving in Eren's squad during the defense of Trost, perishing in the opening clashes against the invading Titans.
Mikasa Ackerman's biological father, a quiet man who lived peacefully with his family in a mountain cabin until he was murdered by human traffickers.
Mikasa Ackerman's mother and a descendant of the Oriental clan within the Walls. She dies defending her daughter when traffickers attack their home.
A Garrison Squad Leader in Trost recognized for her strict discipline and combat skill. She supports Eren's mission to seal the breached gate of Wall Rose.
A recruit of the 104th Cadet Corps who takes part in the defense operations along the Walls alongside his fellow trainees.
A Military Police soldier stationed in the Stohess District alongside Marlo and Annie. Beneath a cynical and carefree exterior, she proves loyal to her comrades.
An elite Squad Leader of the Garrison Regiment in Trost. He sacrifices himself drawing Titans away so Eren can successfully seal the district gate.
Vice-captain and devoted assistant to Hange Zoë in the Scout Regiment. He spends much of his time trying to keep Hange safe from reckless experiments with Titans.
A Scout Regiment officer who takes part in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission led by Commander Erwin Smith.
A Scout Regiment soldier deployed as part of the forces during the 57th expedition beyond the Walls.
A Scout Regiment soldier who survives the Female Titan's ambush and makes the fateful mistake of retrieving a fallen comrade's body, drawing Titans to his group.
A member of the Scout Regiment who accompanies Dieter during the body-recovery mission following the 57th expedition.
Petra Ral's father, unaware of his daughter's death when the Scouts return, who speaks cheerfully to Levi about Petra's future in the squad.
Oluo Bozado's father, belonging to a family proud of their son's service in Captain Levi's Special Operations Squad.
Oluo Bozado's mother, who awaits her son's safe return home from the Scout Regiment's expeditions beyond the Walls.
Gunther Schultz's mother, relative of the loyal member of Levi's elite squad who falls during the 57th expedition.
Gunther Schultz's grandfather, proud of his grandson's service in Captain Levi's Special Operations Squad.
Eld Jinn's mother, whose family awaits the return of Levi's second-in-command inside the Walls.
Eld Jinn's fiancée, who waits for his return from the Scout Regiment's 57th expedition unaware of his death in action.
A veteran Military Police officer in the Stohess District who uses his position to cut deals and stay away from frontline danger.
A Military Police soldier in the Stohess District and fellow 104th trainee alongside Annie Leonhart, characterized by his pragmatic attitude.
Annie Leonhart's adoptive father in Marley, who trained her harshly in martial arts from childhood before regretting his actions and begging her to return home.
An influential merchant of the Reeves Company in Trost who initially blocks evacuation with his cart, but later becomes a key ally of the Scout Regiment.
A member of Hange Zoë's squad in the Scout Regiment who assists in Titan research and key operations inside the Walls.
A young Trost resident rescued by Mikasa during the district's evacuation, inspiring her to idolize Mikasa and later enlist in the military.
The series' narrator, providing historical context on humanity behind the Walls, the three military branches, and key events in each episode.
A Scout Regiment soldier who participates in the regiment's operations and expeditions beyond the Walls.
